relations.subject: command-line-tools-package:8.0.2
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: minted - isBackwardCompatibleWith. No existing predicate captures a directional version-compatibility claim between two package versions of the same tool family; this is distinct from availableSince (a single version floor) and from behavesDifferentlyUnder (a variant axis, not a version-pair claim).
relations.evidence: While command line tools for 7.6.X are not forward compatible with 8.0.X, command line tools for 8.0.X are backward compatible with 7.6.X.

notable_absence.finding: No relation was minted directly stating 'cbimport/cbexport/cbbackupmgr/cbdatarecovery are available starting at package version X' the way cloud/n1ql/n1ql-intro/cbq.json states cbq's availableSince. This page describes the package as a whole (two parallel download/version tracks: 8.0.X and 7.6.X) rather than per-tool version floors, so there is no single availableSince fact to extract per tool beyond the package-level isBackwardCompatibleWith relation already captured.

cross_component_finding: This page repeatedly cites raw server-version-format build strings (e.g. 'cbimport version 8.0.2-5503 (983714b2)', 'SHELL VERSION : 7.6.12-8946', 'GO VERSION : go1.25.5') for a package explicitly named 'Couchbase Server command line tools' rather than a Capella-native artifact - this is a recurrence of the known anomaly (already seen on cbq.json and flagged as expected in this batch's hypothesis) where Capella-adjacent pages cite discrete server-style version strings despite Capella itself having no discrete version number. Not treated as a new finding, only as confirmed recurrence.
